lifecyclePolicy.lexeme: Same masterLexemeId; create the next lexemeRevision; do not overwrite an existing revision file.
lifecyclePolicy.sense: Same masterSenseId; create the next senseRevision; do not overwrite an existing revision file.
lifecyclePolicy.classification: Same classificationId; create the next classificationRevision; do not overwrite an existing revision file.
lifecyclePolicy.taxonomy: Not an entity revision; keep taxonomyId and create a new immutable taxonomyVersion snapshot. No taxonomyRevision field is used.
